hero.eyebrow: MAISON OF PRIVATE CHAUFFEURS · GENEVA & SWISS ALPS
hero.title_part1: The Excellence of Private Chauffeur Service
hero.description: Tailored transfers from Geneva Airport (GVA), executive hourly hire, and first-class Alpine journeys. Smooth driving, strict punctuality, and absolute discretion.

pillars.title: Pillars of Our Service
pillars.subtitle: Exceptional tailored assistance designed for international, diplomatic, and executive clients.
pillars.p1_desc: Real-time tracking of your arrival at Geneva Airport (GVA). Personalised meet & greet in the arrival hall with luggage handling.
pillars.p2_desc: Bilingual suited chauffeurs trained to strict confidentiality protocols. Discrete, refined, and secure transportation at all times.
pillars.p3_desc: Immaculate Mercedes-Benz S-Class, V-Class & Maybach vehicles with leather interiors, tinted glass, and modern amenities.

services.title: Private Chauffeur Tailored to Perfection
services.subtitle: From smooth city transfers to custom Alpine mountain journeys.
services.s1_desc: Seamless connections between Geneva GVA, Geneva-Cornavin, Lausanne, and regional airports. Flight delay monitoring included at no extra charge.
services.s2_desc: Dedicated availability for business meetings, Rue du Rhône shopping sessions, or gala evenings in Geneva and Montreux.
services.s3_desc: Mountain-equipped luxury 4x4 transfers to Chamonix, Courchevel, Megève, Verbier, Zermatt, Crans-Montana, and Gstaad.

fleet.title: Our Fleet of Exceptional Vehicles
fleet.subtitle: Each vehicle is handpicked to offer first-class comfort paired with maximum safety.
fleet.f1_desc: The global benchmark for executive travel. Superior acoustic insulation, heated massaging rear seats, air suspension.
fleet.f2_desc: Private lounge space for group travel, diplomatic delegations, and family ski or golf trips.
fleet.f3_desc: The pinnacle of automotive luxury. Extra legroom, refrigerated console, artisanal finishes, and absolute discretion.

experience.title: The LT On-Board Experience
experience.subtitle: Every detail matters to ensure a relaxing and productive journey.
experience.exp1: Complimentary Évian mineral water bottles & chilled refreshments
experience.exp3: International press, Swiss newspapers, and luxury lifestyle magazines
experience.exp4: VIP child seats & boosters installed upon request

reassurance.title: Why Choose LT Maison de Chauffeurs?
reassurance.r1_desc: Upfront prices guaranteed upon booking. No traffic charges, no hidden fees.
reassurance.r2_desc: Complimentary modification or cancellation up to 24h prior to pickup.
reassurance.r3_desc: Pay online, on-board, or via corporate bank transfer with itemised VAT invoice.

booking.title: PRIVATE BOOKING ENGINE
booking.subtitle: Guaranteed fixed rate with zero hidden costs.
